prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1436; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, in person, by telephone, or in writing.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide a certified copy of the declarations page and confirm the coverage in writing.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, adjuster notes, vehicle data, repair estimates, telematics or dash camera footage, and any other materials in your possession or control. Please suspend any routine destruction or overwriting of such records while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
